text:
You’re the Gym Leader, but you still came all the
way to see us off?\c
Oh, I bet you can already tell that I’m the one
who’ll become the next Champion, yeah?[VAR 0114(0005)]

There are many Trainers who never manage
to gather three Gym Badges, and they just
give up on the Gym Challenge altogether...\c
So I make a point to see off any Trainers who
are able to defeat me.[VAR 0114(0010)]
Whew, we made it...\nThank goodness for Flying Taxis![VAR 0114(000F)]
[VAR 1003][VAR 0100(0000)], Hop, congratulations!\nIt’s pretty amazing you two defeated Kabu![VAR 0114(000F)]

Not a lot of Gym Challengers are able to get a
Gym Badge from Kabu.\c
We like to get together to see them off, as a way
of showing our support.[VAR 0114(000E)]
So, allow me to send you off with a\nproper, sporty chant![VAR 0114(0010)]
Hustle, hustle, hustle, Hop!\nYou can do it, you can do it, [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0010)]

The Gym Leaders you will face ahead are all
tough opponents.\c
But I believe that you will prevail!
Believe in your Pokémon and keep pushing on![VAR 0114(0010)]
Thanks, you all!\c\nWe’re gonna keep winning! We’ve got to if we\nwant a face-off in the Champion Cup, after all![VAR 0114(0005)]
Look into yourself for things you lack.\c\nThose who understand their own weaknesses\nlearn and grow the most![VAR 0114(0010)]

You run into a lot of unexpected things
when you work as a farmer.\c
Same thing with Pokémon battles. Just don’t
give up and things will work out.[VAR 0114(000E)]

There’s nothing wrong with stoically facing
challenges, but push yourselves too hard, and
you’ll pop.\c
If you ever feel maxed out, come up for a
breather at the seafood restaurant.[VAR 0114(000F)]
